W01.drivers: Narrow sloped shoulders and long, thin arms; in profile the trunk is a deep barrel that bulges at both chest and upper back, with a pinched waist above a narrow pelvis; knees sit forward and slightly flexed; spindly limbs with knobby joints. W05 is built the same way.
axial_cues: deep rounded thoracic barrel in profile (front and back bulge)
narrow pelvis with little buttock projection
waist pinch between ribcage and pelvis
limb_cues: slightly flexed, forward knees in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: deep round ribcage in profile over a small, narrow pelvis
structure.joint_integration: thin limbs meet the trunk abruptly; joints read knobby
structure.segment_relations: long arms and slender legs; trunk is mostly ribcage
structure.load_path: weight sits forward on the ribcage, passes through a narrow pelvis to slightly bent knees

non_structural_factors.notes: a slight knee flex adds to the read, but the trunk shape is the main driver

W02.drivers: Normal adult male proportions, moderate shoulders, standard S-curve profile

structure.load_path: vertical through pelvis and straight legs

W03.drivers: Human proportions; in profile a slightly rounded belly and chest and a flat-ish back

structure.axial_section_shape: human, with a slightly fuller abdomen

non_structural_factors.notes: a little softness in the belly

W05.drivers: Nearly identical to W01: narrow sloped shoulders, a deep barrel ribcage bulging front and back in profile, narrow pelvis, long spindly arms, forward and slightly flexed knees

structure.axial_section_shape: deep round ribcage over a small pelvis
structure.joint_integration: abrupt, knobby joints on thin segments
structure.segment_relations: long arms, thin legs, trunk dominated by the ribcage
structure.load_path: weight sits forward, through a narrow pelvis to bent knees

W06.drivers: Normal male build; slightly fuller hips and thighs

W09.drivers: Average male; slightly broad shoulders, upright

W11.drivers: Massive, hypermuscular body; trapezius and shoulder mass rise high; long arms with very large hands hanging at mid-thigh; short, thick legs with heavy calves; very large, wide feet; bent-knee, forward-pitched stance in profile; the back and buttock region is bulky and lumpy. Not just a muscular human: the proportions and joints are reorganized. A detached mesh fragment floats in the profile view.
axial_cues: deep, wide trunk with a plated abdomen
lumpy, bulky back and hip in profile
limb_cues: oversized broad feet with thick toes
ropey, segmented muscle masses at the joints

structure.axial_section_shape: wide, deep, top-heavy trunk tapering to a broad pelvis
structure.joint_integration: joints buried in heavy muscle masses; knobby, segmented transitions
structure.segment_relations: trunk and arms large relative to short legs; hands and feet oversized
structure.load_path: top-heavy mass carried forward through flexed knees onto big, splayed feet

non_structural_factors.notes: muscularity is extreme, but the hand and foot scale and the limb ratios go beyond human

groups.label: ordinary human males (minor fat or tone variation)
slender barrel-chested, narrow-pelvis, long-armed bodies with a slight knee flex
massive top-heavy brute with oversized hands and feet and a bent-knee stance

distinguishing_features: W01 and W05 are thin, with a deep rounded ribcage, a narrow pelvis and spindly limbs: the difference is in the trunk section. W11 is enormously bulky, top-heavy, with oversized hands and feet and short, thick legs: the difference is in mass and segment ratios. The two groups share only a mild bent-knee posture and are otherwise opposite in build.
